_readme: Editable merit formulas. Weights must add up to 100. Every entry carries its sources and a confidence level. If your prospectus says something different, edit the weights here (or use the 'Custom' formula in the app). status/confidence/verify_note are shown to the student so nobody trusts a number blindly.

formulas.name: MDCAT - PMDC pool (Matric 10 / FSc 40 / MDCAT 50)
formulas.authority: PMDC / provincial admission authorities (e.g. UHS Punjab)
formulas.applies_to: MBBS/BDS in public and private colleges that follow the PMDC MDCAT

eligibility.text: Minimum 45% in MDCAT for BDS (reported; NUMS uses 50%)

sources.title: Dawn - UHS issues first merit list for MBBS admission (states the 10/40/50 weightage)
MDCAT aggregate calculator - MDCAT out of 180 (secondary)

formulas.verify_note: Some provinces/institutions have reportedly used different weights (e.g. KMU, federal colleges). Confirm in your province's admission prospectus.

formulas.name: NUMS MDCAT (Matric 10 / FSc 40 / NUMS test 50)
formulas.applies_to: NUMS-affiliated medical/dental colleges (e.g. Army Medical College, CMH)

eligibility.text: Minimum 60% in FSc Pre-Medical (reported by secondary sources)

sources.title: NUMS - Centralized Admissions MBBS/BDS Session 2025-26 (official merit calculation table and pass percentages)
NUMS aggregate formula 2026 (test out of 200 - secondary)

formulas.verify_note: Weights confirmed on the official 2025-26 notice. Test total (200) comes from secondary sources. Some blogs claim 50% FSc + 50% test for Army Medical College: check the current prospectus.

formulas.name: ECAT - UET Lahore (Matric 17 / FSc 50 / ECAT 33)
formulas.applies_to: UET Lahore and UET campuses using the ECAT

components.label: FSc Pre-Engineering (see note)
components.hint: Some calculators use FSc Part-I only (out of 505). Use the marks the prospectus asks for.

formulas.verify_note: Sources disagree on UET weights (17/50/33 vs 25/45/30). No official UET page was available when this was written. CONFIRM with the UET prospectus, or pick the legacy formula / Custom.

formulas.name: ECAT - legacy UET formula (Matric 25 / FSc 45 / ECAT 30)
formulas.applies_to: Older UET cycles; some sites still quote it
formulas.verify_note: Use only if your prospectus says so.

formulas.name: NUST NET (Matric 10 / FSc 15 / NET 75)
formulas.applies_to: NUST undergraduate programs that use the NET

sources.title: University aggregate formulas in Pakistan (worked NET example, secondary)

formulas.verify_note: Only one secondary source was found. Confirm on the NUST admissions page for your intake.

formulas.name: NTS-NAT based universities - generic template (Matric 10 / FSc 40 / NAT 50)
formulas.authority: Each university decides; NTS only conducts the test
formulas.applies_to: Universities that accept the NTS National Aptitude Test

sources.title: University aggregate formulas in Pakistan (secondary, NAT 50/40/10)

formulas.verify_note: NTS does not set merit. EVERY university publishes its own weights: use the 'Custom' formula with the weights from that university's prospectus.
